tool_args.rationale: The forecast horizon is long and the pilot signatures indicate slow-horizon dependence plus a damped fast transient. The existing rows do not adequately separate these effects, so the available fine trajectory batch is the relevant discriminating probe.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a stationary closed-form model from the five paid rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Only five observations are available, all at s_grad=0 and similar long horizons; the slow-horizon signature and fast transient leave temporal mechanism and parameter identifiability unresolved.
It is explicitly a nuisance measurement and does not target the temporal ambiguity.
